strings.text:
How we measured

JavaScript bytes transferred averaged 667kB per visit on ti.to and 85kB on go.tito.io, from five visits to each page in headless Chromium with a fresh browser context and cache disabled each time.

Measured with curl on 23 October 2026: ten requests per page, alternating between sites from one machine. Each request opened a new connection; figures include network time. These live event pages have different content and templates. This measures response time, not throughput.

Existing Tito · Tito on CARLOS 🤖 this bit was written by Claude
